findings.claim: kmctl plugin status --harness antigravity reports a version mismatch with the fix 'run kmctl plugin update', which defaults to --harness claude: following it in an Antigravity-only repository installs Claude Code's skills, settings.json hook and .mcp.json, and leaves .agents/ and .agents/plugins/kmctl/ at the old version. The fix must name the harnesses status was asked about.

The antigravity.py module docstring says plugin status and 'kmctl doctor' share compare_plugin/plugin_problems, but there is no kmctl doctor command (it is the separate ticket kmctl-doctor); the sentence states something false today.
